verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a webhooks API: its webhooks page lists an endpoint to get all webhooks in an account, so webhook subscriptions exist. Nothing in the pack shows which events can be subscribed to, what the payload looks like, or whether it is signed. Missing for 10: subscribable delivery/engagement event types (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes), documented payload schema, payload signing/verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
